LESSON: WRITING 7.3.1 ESSAY WRITING – DESCRIPTIVE COMPOSITION

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.3: Writing 7.3.1 Essay writing – Descriptive composition

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Writing 7.3.1 Essay writing – Descriptive composition. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do we present information in descriptive writing?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify descriptive words from a text on sports and games
2. write a descriptive composition on a topic related to the theme for information

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: WRITING 7.3.1 ESSAY WRITING – DESCRIPTIVE COMPOSITION
This lesson teaches Writing 7.3.1 Essay writing – Descriptive composition for Grade 8 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify descriptive words from a text on sports and games
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. write a descriptive composition on a topic related to the theme for information
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Writing 7.3.1 Essay writing – Descriptive composition using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Writing 7.3.1 Essay writing – Descriptive composition above.
2. Explain Writing 7.3.1 Essay writing – Descriptive composition to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Writing 7.3.1 Essay writing – Descriptive composition.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Writing 7.3.1 Essay writing – Descriptive composition with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Writing 7.3.1 Essay writing – Descriptive composition important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we present information in descriptive writing?
2. Why is it important to consider personal interests when choosing a sport or game?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify descriptive words from a text on sports and games
2. write a descriptive composition on a topic related to the theme for information

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
